sam: DeployBot: lease contention on mig_5202 during shard-merge at 03:42 UTC. Holding change window.
DeployBot: [deploybot] LEASE_ALERT mig_5202 shard=shard-11 inflight=19/24 renew_fail=4
jeni: seeing elevated lock waits on tenant_settings. can we do a soft quiesce for affected tenant ranges instead of full cancel?
omar: yes, selective quiesce + KV snapshot per runbook. prefer handoff to standby worker if possible.
vik: handoff targets: standby-7 (same AZ), standby-2 (cross-AZ). cross-AZ adds 1-2s latency but often succeeds.
sam: decision: attempt standby-7 handoff. if handoff fails -> selective pause + snapshot + pin migration tool to tag infra/mig-1.14.1 and probe extend 25s. rollback threshold: lease lost >45s or inflight >25.
jeni: initiating handoff: ```deploybot handoff mig_5202 --to standby-7 --actor jeni```
DeployBot: HANDOFF_START mig_5202 -> standby-7 at 1789998888
DeployBot: HANDOFF_FAIL mig_5202 reason="worker-unreachable" at 1789998891
omar: ok handoff failed. executing selective pause for tenants 3200-3250.
jeni: ```deploybot pause mig_5202 --tenants 3200-3250 --actor jeni --reason "lease contention"``` -> ack
DeployBot: SELECTIVE_PAUSE_ACK mig_5202 tenants=3200-3250 by jeni at 1789998894
vik: starting KV snapshot hook (runtime). ETA ~40s. tagging runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/migrations#mig_5202
sam: snapshot started. pinning migration tool: infra/mig-1.14.1 to avoid mixed behavior.
ReleaseBot: [releasebot] NOTE_PINNED mig_5202 tag=infra/mig-1.14.1 by sam
omar: snapshot done checksum ok. inflight dropped to 9. running extend probe 25s.
jeni: ```deploybot extend mig_5202 --secs 25 --actor jeni```
DeployBot: EXTEND_FAIL mig_5202 reason="renewal timeout" at 1789998901
sam: extend failed. two choices: try cross-AZ standby-2 handoff OR rollback tenants 3200-3250. given risk of rollback, try standby-2 handoff but alert accounts.
vik: initiating cross-AZ handoff: ```deploybot handoff mig_5202 --to standby-2 --tenant-range 3200-3250 --actor vik```
DeployBot: HANDOFF_OK mig_5202 new_owner=standby-2 latency_spike=1.9s at 1789998904
jeni: resuming tenants at 15% ratecap. ```deploybot ratecap mig_5202 --tenants 3200-3250 --fraction 0.15 --actor jeni```
DeployBot: RATECAP_SET mig_5202 tenants=3200-3250 fraction=0.15 at 1789998905
sam: adding brief release note: "mig_5202: selective pause + KV snapshot; attempted standby handoff; cross-AZ handoff succeeded; resumed at reduced rate; pinned infra/mig-1.14.1"
OncallBot: Reminder: if rollback occurs, follow rollback-hatch checklist and page account teams.
jenI: leaving postmortem stub and telemetry links. close after 20m stable.
